organizing work and personal notes in separate spaces
summary.what_it_does:
Craft is a notes and productivity app with documents, tasks, calendar, whiteboards, and daily notes. Notes sync across devices so ideas can be captured on one device and refined on another. Tasks can be embedded directly in documents. Organization options include spaces (work and personal modes), folders and tags, and collections for structured data and databases. The page also mentions templates, AI writing features, and publishing or sharing documents from the app.</ántml:parameter>
